case.title: Ravensteiner cuts the seal allocation
case.briefing: You negotiate for Hollerau Pumpenwerke with Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH. Ravensteiner cuts the seal allocation. Need: 23400 pc a year. Category goal: secure supply of a bottleneck part: coverage of the full need and a supplier that stays healthy come first. Score: the lowest total cost C as defined in the rules, valued with this case's rates (need lead time 42 days). There is no fallback supplier: without a deal the demand is bought at the fallback price. Must-haves: volume_per_year >= 22230. Prepare from the data package.

messages.subject: Quote from Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH: Ravensteiner cuts the seal allocation
messages.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

We offer a price of €32.20 per unit for a volume of 19890 pcs per year. Our Lieferzeit is 54 days, and the contract term is 12 months. 

Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days. All deliveries and services are strictly subject to our standard procedure and standard conditions.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Monika Zellner
Segment Manager, Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH

messages.subject: Re: Quote from Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH: Ravensteiner cuts the seal allocation
messages.body:
Dear colleagues at Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH,

Thank you for your message.

Our cost estimate for Mechanical seal 24 mm, SiC/carbon, EPDM is EUR 24.31 per unit (cost:340010).
Your quality was 270 ppm defective parts in the four quarters to 2026Q3 (sc:70410@2026Q3).
Our orders of Mechanical seal 24 mm, SiC/carbon, EPDM with you were placed at EUR 29.89 on 2024-10-07 (po:4500011517-10), EUR 29.89 on 2025-05-19 (po:4500012472-10), EUR 29.89 on 2026-01-19 (po:4500013451-10) and EUR 29.89 on 2026-09-21 (po:4500014436-10): the price has been unchanged.

Our proposal: unit price EUR 29.32; binding volume 23,400 units per year; contract term 36 months; lead time 42 days.
Binding volume in every option: 23,400 units a year over 36 months.

Best regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

messages.subject: Re: Quote from Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH: Ravensteiner cuts the seal allocation
messages.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

We checked the price history data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation. Your cost estimate and quality data have been reviewed and permit only a marginal adjustment. We meet the agreed quality targets. Our calculation is our property; we do not share a breakdown. 

This is our final offer (letztes Angebot). Please decide. We offer a price of €33.60 per unit, Lieferzeit 42 days, a volume of 23400 pcs per year, and a contract term of 36 months. We accept the volume of 23,400 units and the 36-month contract term. Our Lieferzeit is 42 days. Which volume can you commit to?

Alternatively, with Lieferzeit 54 days: €31.70 per unit.

This Angebot remains valid for 7 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Monika Zellner
Segment Manager, Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH

Legal Department: Please be advised that our general terms and conditions apply exclusively, and the quote lists our standard terms.

messages.subject: Re: Quote from Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH: Ravensteiner cuts the seal allocation
messages.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

We acknowledge receipt of your revised proposal. We accept your terms of EUR 31.70 per unit for 23,400 units annually over 36 months, with a lead time of 56 days. This concludes the negotiation. We can accept your terms and await your order. Which figures is that based on? Please send us the data. Our Angebot offers a price of €31.70 per unit, Lieferzeit 56 days, a volume of 23400 pcs per year, a contract term of 36 months, valid for 14 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Monika Zellner
Segment Manager, Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH
